description: A field with something attached to it: `https://` before the value, `kg` after it, a Copy button on the end. The GROUP wears the field frame and owns the focus ring; the input inside goes frameless, so the whole thing reads and behaves as one control rather than a box beside a box.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Sits before the value: a unit, a scheme, a currency. Text, or a control.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Sits after it: a unit, a Button, an IconButton.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Red frame + red focus ring. The message belongs to the `<Field>` around it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the affixes with the control inside, so the group reads as one disabled field rather than a live frame around a dead input.

props.name: surface
props.description: Which surface the group sits on — same contract as `<Input surface>`.

props.name: size
props.description: Matches the control inside it; the affixes follow. A group one step off its input reads as two parts that met by accident.

example:
const [slug, setSlug] = useState('acme-handbook')
const [amount, setAmount] = useState('8600.00')

<Stack gap={6}>
  <Field label="Workspace address" htmlFor="workspace-slug">
    <InputGroup prefix="https://" suffix=".example.com" surface="muted">
      <Input
        id="workspace-slug"
        value={slug}
        onChange={(e) => { setSlug(e.target.value) }}
      />
    </InputGroup>
  </Field>
  <Card>
    <Field label="Invoice total" htmlFor="amount">
      <InputGroup prefix="SAR" suffix="incl. VAT">
        <Input
          id="amount"
          inputMode="decimal"
          value={amount}
          onChange={(e) => { setAmount(e.target.value) }}
        />
      </InputGroup>
    </Field>
  </Card>
</Stack>
